title: Trainline European Station
description: One row of the ODbL-licensed European station database Trainline publishes at https://github.com/trainline-eu/stations. Derived by API Evangelist from the real stations.csv header row and the column documentation in the repository README on 2026-07-28; no field has been invented. The source file is semicolon-delimited CSV with booleans encoded as 't'/'f' and empty strings for null; this schema describes the normalised JSON projection of a row.

name.description: Station name as it is locally known.

slug.description: URL-safe unique identifier; present for suggestable stations.

uic8_sncf.description: SNCF's 8-digit UIC variant, i.e. the UIC code plus a checksum digit.

parent_station_id.description: id of the meta-station this station is grouped under.

hub_id.description: id of the hub this station belongs to.

time_zone.description: IANA tz database identifier, e.g. Europe/Paris.

is_city.description: Station represents a city rather than a single physical station.

is_main_station.description: Station is the main station of its city.

is_suggestable.description: Station may be offered in search suggestions.

country_hint.description: Country should be displayed alongside the name to disambiguate it.

main_station_hint.description: Main-station status should be displayed alongside the name.

sncf_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on SNCF (France).

entur_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on Entur (Norway).

db_id.description: Station identifier used by Deutsche Bahn (Germany) (db_id).

db_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on Deutsche Bahn (Germany).

busbud_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on Busbud.

distribusion_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on Distribusion.

flixbus_id.description: Station identifier used by FlixBus / FlixTrain (flixbus_id).

flixbus_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on FlixBus / FlixTrain.

cff_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on CFF/SBB (Switzerland).

obb_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on ÖBB (Austria).

trenitalia_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on Trenitalia (Italy).

trenord_id.description: Station identifier used by Trenord (Lombardy, Italy) (trenord_id).

ntv_id.description: Station identifier used by NTV / Italo (Italy) (ntv_id).

ntv_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on NTV / Italo (Italy).

renfe_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on Renfe (Spain).

cercanias_id.description: Station identifier used by Renfe Cercanías (Spain) (cercanias_id).

cercanias_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on Renfe Cercanías (Spain).

atoc_id.description: Station identifier used by ATOC / RDG — CRS code (Great Britain) (atoc_id).

atoc_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on ATOC / RDG — CRS code (Great Britain).

benerail_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on Benerail (Belgium/Netherlands).

westbahn_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on WESTbahn (Austria).

smt_is_enabled.description: Station is enabled for sale/search on SMT.

sncf_self_service_machine.description: An SNCF self-service ticket machine is available at this station.

same_as.description: id of the canonical station record when this row duplicates another.

info:de.description: Locally relevant information about the station in German (ISO 639-1 'de').

info:en.description: Locally relevant information about the station in English (ISO 639-1 'en').

info:es.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Spanish (ISO 639-1 'es').

info:fr.description: Locally relevant information about the station in French (ISO 639-1 'fr').

info:it.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Italian (ISO 639-1 'it').

info:nb.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Norwegian Bokmål (ISO 639-1 'nb').

info:nl.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Dutch (ISO 639-1 'nl').

info:cs.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Czech (ISO 639-1 'cs').

info:da.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Danish (ISO 639-1 'da').

info:hu.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Hungarian (ISO 639-1 'hu').

info:ja.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Japanese (ISO 639-1 'ja').

info:ko.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Korean (ISO 639-1 'ko').

info:pl.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Polish (ISO 639-1 'pl').

info:pt.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Portuguese (ISO 639-1 'pt').

info:ru.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Russian (ISO 639-1 'ru').

info:sv.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Swedish (ISO 639-1 'sv').

info:tr.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Turkish (ISO 639-1 'tr').

info:zh.description: Locally relevant information about the station in Chinese (ISO 639-1 'zh').

normalised_code.description: Cross-source location identifier expressed as a Trainline URN, e.g. urn:trainline:public:nloc:csv1.

iata_airport_code.description: IATA airport code, for stations that serve an airport.
